description: District Secretariat Galle - Amended Annual Duruthu Maha Festival Procession of Pilana Purana Sri Maha Temple. Amended Ex. Gaz. No. 2359/04 on 20.11.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the scheduled dates for a religious festival (Annual Duruthu Maha Festival and Procession) under the Pilgrimages Ordinance. It constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it involves the modification of a previously gazetted schedule through statutory authority, specifically under the Pilgrimages Ordinance framework.
